subject: general
question: Who among the following is called 'father of Indian constitution'?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Bhim Rao Ambedkar.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Bhim Rao Ambedkar is known as the** 'father of the Indian Constitution' **for his pivotal role in drafting the Constitution of India.
 
• He was the **Chairman of the Drafting Committee** and played a crucial role in incorporating fundamental rights and social justice provisions.
 
• Ambedkar** advocated for the rights of marginalized communities** and was a strong proponent of equality and individual rights.
 
• His contributions reflect his deep understanding of social justice, law, and governance.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **P Subbarayan:**

 
 
• An Indian politician and member of the Indian National Congress who served as a **member of the Constituent Assembly.**
 
• He was instrumental in advocating for the **rights of marginalized communities** but is not primarily associated with the Constitution's drafting.
 
• Subbarayan held various political positions and contributed to the discussions during the framing of the Constitution.
 
 
 
• **Gopinath Bordoloi:**
 
 
• A prominent Indian politician from Assam who served as the **Chief Minister of Assam.**
 
• He was a member of the Constituent Assembly and played a role in representing the** interests of the northeastern states.**
 
• Bordoloi is known for his **efforts to integrate Assam **into independent India but is not recognized as a key figure in the Constitution's drafting.
 
 
 
• **Rajendra Prasad:**
 
 
• The** first President of India** and a key leader in the Indian independence movement.
 
• He was also a member of the Constituent Assembly and played an important role in the discussions surrounding the Constitution.
 
• Prasad was also the **President of the Constituent Assembly **that drafted the Constitution of India.
 
• He chaired the Constituent Assembly's **committee on food and agriculture.**
